xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #2378 (triage:summary legacy vbrief/.eval/ path doc-drift cleanup).

plan.title: Normalize triage:summary history-path docs off the legacy vbrief/.eval/ prefix

narratives.Description: The functional bug reported in #2378 (triage:summary writing a stray top-level vbrief/.eval/summary-history.jsonl on an xbrief-layout project) is ALREADY FIXED on main: the write site (packages/cli/src/triage-summary.ts and packages/core/src/triage/welcome/summary.ts) resolves the path via resolveTriageCachePath -> resolveLifecycleRoot, which selects xbrief/ on a migrated tree and writes <lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/summary-history.jsonl. That behavior landed with #1703 (.eval/ -> .triage-cache/ relocation) and #2109 (layout-aware root resolution). What remains is user-facing DOC/STRING drift that still advertises the legacy hardcoded prefix and the pre-#1703 subdir. This story normalizes those references; no runtime write-path change.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Taskfile.yml (~line 872): the triage:summary alias desc still reads 'appends a JSONL record to vbrief/.eval/summary-history.jsonl' -- wrong on BOTH counts (.eval/ subdir and hardcoded vbrief/ prefix). Update it to '<lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/summary-history.jsonl' to match the already-correct include fragment tasks/triage-summary.yml:24. 2. packages/core/src/triage/help/registry-data.ts (~line 9): the triage:summary help entry hardcodes 'vbrief/.triage-cache/summary-history.jsonl'; make it layout-neutral '<lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/summary-history.jsonl'. 3. Update/confirm any help-registry contract test that pins the help string. Leave the SUMMARY_HISTORY_REL_PATH display constants (triage/summary/index.ts, triage/welcome/constants.ts) OUT of scope -- they are covered by the #2112 vbrief-removal normalization sweep and share files/tests with it (see conflict_group). Reply on #2378 confirming the functional fix shipped in the 0.71.x line and close-as-fixed once the doc normalization merges.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator reading triage:summary help / Taskfile descriptions, I want the documented history-path to match where the file is actually written (<lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/), so the docs don't point me at a legacy vbrief/.eval/ path that the engine no longer uses.
narratives.Overview: Filed against engine v0.68.1 (pre-#1703). Reporter explicitly asked to confirm-or-close on latest. Confirmed fixed functionally; only doc/help drift remains. Evidence cited in the issue: Taskfile.yml desc and tasks/triage-summary.yml (the latter is already correct on main). This is a patch-safe, string-only cleanup.

items.title: Given the Taskfile triage:summary desc, when read, then it names <lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/summary-history.jsonl

narrative.Acceptance: Given Taskfile.yml, when the triage:summary alias desc is read, then it no longer contains 'vbrief/.eval/' and matches the tasks/triage-summary.yml include fragment wording.

items.title: Given the triage:summary help entry, when rendered, then it names a layout-neutral <lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/ path

narrative.Acceptance: Given packages/core/src/triage/help/registry-data.ts, when the triage:summary help string is rendered, then it references '<lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/summary-history.jsonl' with no hardcoded 'vbrief/' prefix, and any pinning contract test is updated to match.

expected_outputs: no user-facing triage:summary doc references the legacy vbrief/.eval/ path; help + Taskfile desc read <lifecycle-root>/.triage-cache/summary-history.jsonl
